3
Paulo dwumadie wɔ amanaman mufoɔ mu
1 # Flp 1.7; 1.13 Yei nti na me Paulo, meyɛ Kristo Yesu deduani ma mo amanaman mufoɔ, 2sɛ ebia moate ofiehwɛ-adwuma a Nyankopɔn adom a mo nti wɔde adom me no, 3#Efe 1.9-10 sɛ ɔnam adiyie so maa mehunuu ahuntasɛm no, sɛdeɛ matwerɛ no tiawa mu dada no. 4Sɛ mokekan a, mode bɛhunu nteaseɛ a mewɔ wɔ Kristo ahuntasɛm no ho 5#Kol 1.26 a awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bi mu, wɔamma nnipa mma anhunu, sɛdeɛ wɔayi no adi nnansa yi akyerɛ n’asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ kronkron, wɔ honhom mu, 6#Efe 2.13; 2.18-19 sɛ amanaman mufoɔ nso bɛyɛ adedifoɔ ne nipadua korɔ no ara bi, na wɔnam asɛmpa no so anya kyɛfa wɔ ne bɔhyɛ no ho bi wɔ Kristo Yesu mu. 7Ɛno ho na wɔayɛ me somfoɔ, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdeɛ a wɔde akyɛ me, ne tumi adwumayɛ no soɔ, teɛ no.
8 # 1 Ko 15.9-10; Efe 1.7; Gal 1.16 Me a mene ahotefoɔ nyinaa mu akumaa na wɔde adom yi adom me, sɛ menka Kristo ahonya a emu nni hwehwɛbea no ho asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanaman mufoɔ, 9#Rom 16.25; Kol 1.16 na memma nnipa nyinaa nhunu ahuntasɛm a ɛfiri tete berɛ so huntaa wɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ nnoɔma nyinaa no mu no ho dwumadie no, 10#1 Pe 1.12; Rom 11.33 sɛ afei wɔmfa asafo no so mma mpaninnie ne tumi ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ soro hɔnom nhunu Nyankopɔn nyansa bebree no, 11#Efe 1.11 sɛdeɛ ne tirim a ɔbɔɔ no teteete yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu mu no teɛ no. 12#Yoh 14.6; Heb 4.16; Rom 5.2 Ne mu na yɛnam ne ho gyidie so anya nnamyɛ ne kwan, ahotosoɔ mu. 13#Kol 1.24 Enti mesrɛ sɛ mommpa aba m’amaneɛ a mo nti mehunu a ɛne mo animuonyam no mu.
Paulo adesrɛ
14Yei nti na mede me nkotodwe mekoto Agya 15a wɔfiri ne mu frɛ abusua biara a ɛwɔ soro ne asase soɔ no, 16#Efe 1.7; 6.10 sɛ ɔmfiri n’animuonyam ahonya mu mma momfa ne honhom so nnya tumi mu ahoɔden wɔ mo mu nipa su no mu; 17#Yoh 14.23; Kol 2.7 na ɔmma Kristo mfa gyidie so ntena mo akoma mu, na moagye ɔdɔ mu nhini atim mu, 18na mo ne ahotefoɔ nyinaa anya trɛ ne tentene ne korɔn ne emudɔ no, 19na moahunu Kristo dɔ a ɛtra nhunumu no, na Nyankopɔn mayɛ nyinaa ayɛ mo ma awie.
20Na deɛ ɔtumi yɛ ma no tra ade nyinaa, ma no boro so kyɛne deɛ yɛsrɛ anaasɛ yesusuo, sɛdeɛ tumi a ɛyɛ yɛn mu adwuma no teɛ no, 21ɔno na animuonyam nka no asafo no mu, Kristo Yesu mu, mfa nkɔ berɛsanten a ɛbɛba no ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Amen.

pageProps.chapterText:
Yei nti na me Paulo, meyɛ Kristo Yesu deduani ma mo amanaman mufoɔ, sɛ ebia moate ofiehwɛ-adwuma a Nyankopɔn adom a mo nti wɔde adom me no, sɛ ɔnam adiyie so maa mehunuu ahuntasɛm no, sɛdeɛ matwerɛ no tiawa mu dada no. Sɛ mokekan a, mode bɛhunu nteaseɛ a mewɔ wɔ Kristo ahuntasɛm no ho a awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ bi mu, wɔamma nnipa mma anhunu, sɛdeɛ wɔayi no adi nnansa yi akyerɛ n’asomafoɔ ne adiyifoɔ kronkron, wɔ honhom mu, sɛ amanaman mufoɔ nso bɛyɛ adedifoɔ ne nipadua korɔ no ara bi, na wɔnam asɛmpa no so anya kyɛfa wɔ ne bɔhyɛ no ho bi wɔ Kristo Yesu mu. Ɛno ho na wɔayɛ me somfoɔ, sɛdeɛ Nyankopɔn adom akyɛdeɛ a wɔde akyɛ me, ne tumi adwumayɛ no soɔ, teɛ no.
Me a mene ahotefoɔ nyinaa mu akumaa na wɔde adom yi adom me, sɛ menka Kristo ahonya a emu nni hwehwɛbea no ho asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanaman mufoɔ, na memma nnipa nyinaa nhunu ahuntasɛm a ɛfiri tete berɛ so huntaa wɔ Onyankopɔn a ɔbɔɔ nnoɔma nyinaa no mu no ho dwumadie no, sɛ afei wɔmfa asafo no so mma mpaninnie ne tumi ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ soro hɔnom nhunu Nyankopɔn nyansa bebree no, sɛdeɛ ne tirim a ɔbɔɔ no teteete yɛn Awurade Kristo Yesu mu no teɛ no. Ne mu na yɛnam ne ho gyidie so anya nnamyɛ ne kwan, ahotosoɔ mu. Enti mesrɛ sɛ mommpa aba m’amaneɛ a mo nti mehunu a ɛne mo animuonyam no mu.

Yei nti na mede me nkotodwe mekoto Agya a wɔfiri ne mu frɛ abusua biara a ɛwɔ soro ne asase soɔ no, sɛ ɔmfiri n’animuonyam ahonya mu mma momfa ne honhom so nnya tumi mu ahoɔden wɔ mo mu nipa su no mu; na ɔmma Kristo mfa gyidie so ntena mo akoma mu, na moagye ɔdɔ mu nhini atim mu, na mo ne ahotefoɔ nyinaa anya trɛ ne tentene ne korɔn ne emudɔ no, na moahunu Kristo dɔ a ɛtra nhunumu no, na Nyankopɔn mayɛ nyinaa ayɛ mo ma awie.
Na deɛ ɔtumi yɛ ma no tra ade nyinaa, ma no boro so kyɛne deɛ yɛsrɛ anaasɛ yesusuo, sɛdeɛ tumi a ɛyɛ yɛn mu adwuma no teɛ no, ɔno na animuonyam nka no asafo no mu, Kristo Yesu mu, mfa nkɔ berɛsanten a ɛbɛba no ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Amen.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
